annotations.title: Quote or prepare a PT trade

description: Quote buying a Principal Token (locks a fixed rate) or selling it before maturity, on EVM markets. Without receiver it returns a quote only. With receiver it also returns UNSIGNED transactions (an exact-amount ERC-20 approval if needed, then the Spectra router call) for the user to review and sign in their own wallet. Nothing is signed or broadcast. The router address is checked against pinned Spectra routers.

amount.description: Input amount in token units (not wei): e.g. "1000" for 1,000 USDC when buying, or PT units when selling.

market.description: Market id from spectra_find_yields (e.g. "base:0xa07f…"), a PT or pool address (prefix the chain when you know it), or a symbol fragment such as "sjEUR".

receiver.description: Wallet receiving the output. Required to get transactions.

sender.description: Wallet that signs (defaults to receiver); used to check the existing allowance.

side.description: buy = pay with the underlying/IBT to receive PT; sell = sell PT.

token.description: Token paid (buy) or received (sell): "underlying" (default), "ibt", or that token's address.

name: spectra_prepare_pt_trade
title: Quote or prepare a PT trade
